prep.title: What to prepare
prep.item1: Bring your ID card and the 6-character interview code to enter at the office Kiosk.
prep.item2: Arrive about 10 minutes early so there is time to check your microphone and camera.
prep.item3: The interview code is single-use and expires 2 hours after it is issued.

practiceCard.title: Practice before the real thing
practiceCard.description: Each round includes one practice interview so you can get used to the AI — it does not affect your hiring result.
